Agentic search swarms are starting to outperform top-tier models on specialized benchmarks.

As AI tooling shifts toward multi-agent coordination and deeper tool execution, today's updates highlight a strong focus on developer control and operational efficiency.

Here are the key technical developments reported today:

🤖 SID AI released SID-2, an agentic search model trained with reinforcement learning. A single agent reaches 0.585 NDCG in 3.11 seconds, while a 12-agent SID-2 Swarm scores 0.720 NDCG, outperforming GPT-6 Astra on SID’s benchmark.

⚡ Anthropic added Code Mode to Claude Code v2.1.323. This experimental feature lets Claude write JavaScript that chains Bash, Read, and Edit tool calls in 1 step, while keeping the chat active during long command runs.

🧠 OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, bringing improved professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower costs across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.

💻 Microsoft launched 7 AI models designed to challenge OpenAI.

🎨 Google showcased projects from 5 builders working with Gemini 4 Carbon.

From chaining terminal tool calls in JavaScript to running multi-agent search swarms, developer control over execution pipelines continues to expand rapidly.
